sentence: This project tries to make antibody-drug conjugates work better against triple-negative breast cancer and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
This project adapts a brief digitally-enhanced intervention for anxiety sensitivity and intolerance of uncertainty in heavy alcohol users receiving medication for opioid use disorder.
This project builds a CRISPR-based toolkit to study how transcription factors shape hair cell development in inner ear organoids.
This project offers imaging and spatial transcriptomics services to help researchers study kidney tissue.
This project places genetically engineered bacteria inside implantable materials to deliver anticancer therapeutics against pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how the protein Caveolin-1 helps Ewing Sarcoma cells adapt, using imaging, computational analysis, and zebrafish disease models.
This project tests drugs to see whether they increase healthy lifespan in mice.
This project provides imaging equipment and expertise so researchers can study cancer in animal models and humans.
This project provides a course on population health cancer research that uses cancer-related databases.
This project compares computer methods that recognize immune reactions to colorectal cancer with expert pathologists to improve predictions of survival.
This project provides CRISPR genome engineering and induced pluripotent stem cell services for cancer cells and animal models.
This project builds a machine learning method to assess the rupture risk of thoracic aortic aneurysm.
This project studies the genetic, epigenetic, biochemical, and metabolic pathways that drive cancer initiation and metastasis.
This project builds a robotic system guided by real-time magnetic resonance imaging to improve needle placement for abdominal cancers.
This project studies how dysfunctional mitochondrial quality control contributes to cerebrovascular disease and neurodegenerative disease.
This project tries to find out how aging of T cells causes inflammation and dysfunction of the arteries.
This project improves a knowledgebase of cancer variants by making its data more accessible through visualization and graph-based search.
This project studies how Epstein-Barr virus infection works with oncogenes and tumor suppressors to cause lymphomas in mouse models.
This project develops a method that stretches cell membranes to create temporary pores and deliver DNA-editing proteins into human immune cells.
This project studies whether sleep and negative affect link cannabis use to depression, using wearable biosensors.
